_comment: Configurable weights and severities (spec: not hard-coded). ASSUMPTION documented in ARCHITECTURE.md: TIME=MAJOR (the two user specs disagree: CRITICAL in one, MODERATE in an example of the other).
_irreversible_actions_comment: E-MCP/E-AUTONOMOUS (2026-09-30): a NARROWER list than destructive_actions, used only by aixl/negotiation.py to decide whether an actions-dimension disagreement must escalate to REJECT instead of being auto-resolved by trusting the sender. destructive_actions (used for compare's own CRITICAL severity display) also includes UPDATE/DISABLE, which are common and usually reversible — reusing the full list here broke the real 'Close ticket' vs 'Delete ticket' case (UPDATE is on both sides of countless ordinary disagreements). First scoped to DELETE alone (the only one 3 real test pairs actually confirmed). Widened the same day to also cover EXECUTE (a one-way trigger: running something usually can't be undone) and SEND (a message sent usually can't be unsent), at the user's explicit request and on the same reasoning as DELETE — UPDATE and DISABLE stay OUT deliberately (common, usually reversible). EXECUTE/SEND are not yet backed by a real disagreement case the way DELETE was; re-measured against the real 21 E-INTEROP disagreements immediately after widening to check for new false-positive escalations before trusting this.
_action_groups_comment: ASSUMPTION (added after blind run 1): actions in the same group are treated as the same task for equivalence; the first item is the representative. Blind authors treated Crea/Escribe, Fetch/Get, Busca/Localiza, Verifica/Valida as the same instruction. Configurable: set to [] for strict lexical actions.
